verdicts.sd_module_sound: works on the camera (played to the end, owner heard it)
verdicts.exif_orientation_3: works on the camera: the upside-down photo was saved with Orientation 3, so the Z7 records pose 3
verdicts.af_area_shortcut_trial: works on the camera (owner observed the switch; its log entry was overwritten)
verdicts.photo_trigger: unsolved: the still-file callback 0xA18D2750 never fired for 7 JPEG photos, and no event on the other two callbacks counts 7; the provisional still-file trigger would not work
